findings.problem: The sentence "Thank you for joining the waitlist for The Steep Club. If you've been thinking of this as a gift for someone, you asked to be the first to know when we opened — so here we are." has a conditional clause that doesn't logically connect to the following clause, reading as a non-sequitur. Not a brand-voice or rules violation, but a clarity/plain-English issue (the other two group variants handle the same personalization insertion cleanly).
findings.fix: Rewrite as: "Thank you for joining the waitlist for The Steep Club. You asked to be the first to know when we opened — so here we are, and if you've been thinking of this as a gift for someone, you're in the right place."
